name: Familial Advanced Sleep Phase Syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Familial Advanced Sleep Phase Syndrome Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Consistent habitual sleep onset at least 3 hours earlier than conventional bedtime
Inability to stay asleep beyond early morning hours, typically waking 3-4 hours before desired time
Presence of similar advanced sleep phase pattern in at least one first-degree relative
Normal total sleep duration despite shifted timing
Exclusion of other primary sleep disorders or psychiatric conditions

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All three major criteria (early sleep onset, early morning awakening, and positive family history) must be met.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical and may be supported by actigraphy or sleep diary data.
